probe.text_sample: About | Maren Vik Skip to content Bergen --:--:-- Maren Vik, home Work Services About Journal Contact Overview Menu Work Services About Journal Contact Overview Available from November Maren Vik, Bergen, 2026 About I photograph people, objects and rooms in the light they already have. I grew up in Bergen and trained as a set designer before I picked up a camera. That still shapes how I work: I build the frame first, then wait for the light to fill it. Most of my work is for fashion labels, skincare brands and small studios that make things by hand. I shoot on location or in natural light studios, with a small team and as little equipment as the job allows. When I'm not on a commission I work on personal series, some of which end up as printed editions.
